ties: Exact equality of float64 round-trip values; no rounding; every tied hour has weight 1/tied_count
daily_scope: Only days marked day_complete with 24 strict hours
changes_scope: Continuous hourly grid, including valid hours on incomplete days; both endpoints strict-valid and exactly one hour apart; cross-midnight retained and labelled
threshold_fit: Frozen task01 training interval only; both change endpoints inside training

case_selection.comparison_month: Earliest full calendar month with every day complete, at least 5 natural weekdays and 4 natural weekend days
case_selection.typical_weekday: Complete natural weekday in comparison month closest to its group's daily-energy median; exact distance ties choose earliest date
case_selection.typical_weekend: Complete natural weekend in the same month closest to its group's daily-energy median; exact distance ties choose earliest date
case_selection.high_load: In the same month, smallest daily energy at or above the month's q95 (linear); energy ties choose earliest date
case_selection.global_peak: Across all strict complete days, largest hourly peak; exact ties choose earliest date
case_selection.purpose: Retrospective descriptive case selection only, never a task06 fitted threshold or feature
